analysis.title: Inside the cellular factory
analysis.description: A comparative educational slide presenting cell division as a factory process. The slide contains two framed side-by-side panels: the left panel illustrates 'Interphase' with duplicated cellular machinery and DNA, and the right panel illustrates 'Mitosis & Cytokinesis' showing chromosome separation and cell division. At the bottom center, a connected callout card synthesizes the outcome.
analysis.layout: The title spans the top left. Below the title are two symmetrical framed cards side-by-side: left card covers Interphase with text at top and a circular cell diagram with 'x2' duplication callouts below; right card covers Mitosis & Cytokinesis with text at top and a dividing cell diagram below. Blue circuit-like connecting lines branch from the bottom of both cards into a single callout box centered at the bottom.
